title: Return a greeting
summary: FastAPI: Return a greeting. Change the greeting.
introduction: A route decorator maps GET / to a function. PlainTextResponse makes a plain text reply.

blocks.text: Install fastapi and uvicorn with python -m pip install fastapi uvicorn. Save one example as app.py and run uvicorn app:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000. Use the stated route on that address.

blocks.title: Return a greeting
blocks.code:
from fastapi import FastAPI, Query, HTTPException, Response, status
from fastapi.responses import PlainTextResponse, RedirectResponse
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
app = FastAPI()
@app.get("/", response_class=PlainTextResponse)
def hello():
    return "Hello, Asha!"

blocks.text: The response_class setting writes the returned value as plain text rather than a JSON string.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Without a text response class, a returned string is sent as JSON text.
